thread:
anna-partnerships: FYI — ACME reported ~3% of appliance usage missing in marketplace reports for the last 48h. Looks like offline-device replay gaps when device clock drifted >5m. Need a reconciliation playbook + a short customer-facing billing note. Filing here to coordinate. https://redwood.internal/partnerships/acme/metering-incident-1776543210

sam-billing: Oof. Do we have a quick way to identify affected customers and entitlements? Need exact delta for invoices.

josh-engineer: We can detect via missing `sequence_number` continuity on their hourly batches. Query I ran showed ~4200 hourly rows with a gap pattern across 74 customers.

mei-ops: Can you paste the query? also what caused the replay to skip?

josh-engineer: Query snippet: ```sql
SELECT partner_id, hour, min(sequence_number) as start_sn, max(sequence_number) as end_sn, count(*)
FROM marketplace.hourly_events
WHERE partner = 'acme' AND created_at >= now() - interval '72 hours'
GROUP BY partner_id, hour
HAVING (end_sn - start_sn + 1) != count(*)
```

josh-engineer: Root cause: older appliance firmware sends wall-clock timestamps, some devices drift and replay uploader dedup logic deems late batches as duplicates. We should treat monotonic sequence_number as source of truth.

ben-liaison: What's customer impact? revenue amount range? they already pinged their finance team. They want a calm, clear note.

sam-billing: Preliminary exposure estimate: ~3% of usage for impacted hours => ~$12k gross for last invoice period (pre-credit). Need reconciliation plan before next bill run.

marketplace-bot: [automated] Created incident ticket #INC-2026-2487 and attached ingestion logs.

anna-partnerships: Proposed playbook steps: 1) detect affected partner_id/hour rows, 2) re-run uploader with sequence-based dedupe, 3) backfill ledger entries to staging, 4) run credit job to emit adjustments, 5) notify customer with clear billing note + timeline.

mei-ops: Timeline: can we run detection + backfill in a maintenance window tonight? Ops can run backfill for non-peak hours (0100-0400 PT). Need sign-off from billing and partnership.

sam-billing: Billing ok with backfill if we can ensure idempotency and proof of adjustments. Need audit CSV: partner_id, hour, original_usage, backfilled_usage, adjustment_amount, reason_code.

josh-engineer: I'll add a `backfill_proof` dump to S3 and produce the CSV. Example webhook missing fields that caused issue: 
```json
{
  "partner": "acme",
  "device_id": "ap-12345",
  "timestamp": "2025-10-11T03:00:00Z",
  "sequence_number": null,
  "usage_tokens": 120
}
```

anna-partnerships: For customer-facing wording draft: "We detected a small subset of usage events from ACME appliances that were not included in marketplace reports due to device clock drift causing replay gaps. We will apply a one-time adjustment to reflect the missing usage; no action required on your side. A reconciliation summary will be provided by <date/time>." Thoughts? @ben-liaison

ben-liaison: That reads fine. Add a line: "If you’d like an itemized reconciliation, reply and we’ll provide a CSV."

legal-ops: Quick note — avoid promising exact dollar amounts until backfill completes. Can say "expected to be small; adjustments will be applied if required." I can sign off after final wording.

anna-partnerships: ack. I'll update. Who owns sending the customer note?

sam-billing: Partnerships can send the initial note, billing will send the formal invoice adjustment + CSV within 5 business days after backfill completes.

mei-ops: Ops will run detection tonight at 01:00 PT and hold backfill until we have go-ahead (post-verify).

josh-engineer: I'll push the uploader patch that switches to sequence_number-first dedupe to staging by EOD. Patch: `ensure(seq_number IS NOT NULL) THEN dedupe ON seq_number ELSE fallback timestamp-dedupe`

anna-partnerships: Action items: 
- anna-partnerships: draft customer note + ping legal for signoff (today)
- josh-engineer: produce detection query & S3 backfill_proof (EOD)
- mei-ops: schedule detection job 01:00 PT, hold backfill until verification
- sam-billing: prepare adjustment CSV template and billing instructions
- ben-liaison: prep ACME contact & expectation email

sam-billing: please tag me when the S3 proof is ready so I can validate amounts. :thumbsup:

anna-partnerships: will do. cc @legal-ops for signoff once I update wording. :email:

ben-liaison: ACME appreciates the quick coord. they asked for a short blurb we can co-send.

marketplace-bot: [automated] Linked incident #INC-2026-2487 -> playbook runbook draft created at https://redwood.internal/playbooks/acme-recon-1776543210

anna-partnerships: Thanks everyone — will post updates here as things complete.
